## 发布流水线优化

本次预览版优化了 Docker 多架构发布流程：`amd64` 与 `arm64` 改为原生并行构建并复用分架构缓存，运行时基础镜像改为独立定期刷新。镜像仍会经过双架构冒烟测试、Docker Scout、安全证明材料和摘要一致性校验后再发布。

产品功能与 `1.4.0-preview.2` 一致。HTTP/HTTPS `.strm` 支持仍为实验功能，仅支持指向直接媒体资源的 HTTP/HTTPS 地址；暂不支持 RTSP、MMS、HLS/M3U8、自定义请求头或 Cookie，也不提供远程转码。

如遇到扫描、匹配、拖动播放或兼容性问题，欢迎通过 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/RichesChiu/mova/issues) 或 [Telegram](https://t.me/mova_feedback) 反馈。

从 `1.4.0-preview.2` 升级无需数据库迁移、媒体库重扫或缓存重建。

---

## Release pipeline optimization

This preview optimizes the Docker multi-platform release pipeline. Native `amd64` and `arm64` builds now run in parallel with architecture-specific caches, while runtime base images are refreshed independently on a schedule. Images still pass per-platform smoke tests, Docker Scout, supply-chain attestation, and digest consistency gates before publication.

Product behavior is unchanged from `1.4.0-preview.2`. HTTP/HTTPS `.strm` support remains experimental and is limited to direct HTTP/HTTPS media resources. RTSP, MMS, HLS/M3U8, custom request headers or cookies, and remote transcoding are not supported.

Please report scanning, matching, seeking, or compatibility problems through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/RichesChiu/mova/issues) or [Telegram](https://t.me/mova_feedback).

Upgrading from `1.4.0-preview.2` does not require a database migration, media library rescan, or cache rebuild.
